title: 99 Sandy Shores Ct
meta_description: Experience luxury and relaxation at this beautifully decorated 30A Gulfview vacation home with a private heated infinity pool, Gulf views, direct beach access, and easy walkability to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach.

normalized_matching_profile.name: 99 Sandy Shores Ct
normalized_matching_profile.description: Description30A Coastal Retreat at 99 Sandy Shores – Luxury Vacation Home with Gulf ViewsEscape to this stunning 30A Gulfview vacation home, ideally located between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, both just a short walk away. With breathtaking Gulf views, direct access to a private beach, and a heated infinity pool, this luxury property offers the perfect blend of relaxation and convenience for your dream getaway.This home features over 3,500 sq ft of beautifully designed living space, plus 1,000 sq ft of porches and balconies to enjoy the Gulf breeze. Enjoy a spacious chef’s kitchen, comfortable king bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, a family-friendly playroom, and tranquil outdoor areas perfect for lounging by the pool or dining alfresco with Gulf views.The lower level offers a spacious 20' x 25' playroom, ideal for family fun. It also features an extra-long built-in twin bed bunk room, perfect for additional guests, and a comfortable king bedroom with a full bath for a peaceful retreat. A well-equipped laundry room includes an extra refrigerator and ice maker for added convenience.The expansive main level on the 2nd floor features a large living area with comfortable seating, perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach. The well-equipped chef’s kitchen includes Kitchen Aid appliances, a 48-inch built-in refrigerator, and a spacious dining table that seats 12, with additional bar seating for 4. Two king bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms provide privacy and comfort, while a bunk room with two twin beds is ideal for younger guests. The wraparound porch offers stunning Gulf and pool views, with outdoor lounge seating and a round dining table for alfresco meals.The third floor takes you to the private master suite boasting a luxurious king bed and direct access to a balcony with breathtaking Gulf views and sunset vistas. A work desk with panoramic views is the perfect spot for catching up on emails or enjoying a quiet moment. The master suite also includes a spacious walk-in closet and a travertine bathroom for a truly relaxing experience.The pool area features a covered outdoor patio with two distinct areas, including an outdoor dining table and a covered seating area overlooking the infinity-edge pool with a 65" TV for poolside entertainment. An outdoor bathroom with a toilet, hot/cold shower, and changing stall adds convenience. The private infinity pool can be heated to your preference, and the pool area leads to a back gate with direct access to the beach via a boardwalk.Experience the best of 30A in this luxurious and centrally located coastal retreat. Ideal for families, friends, or a romantic getaway, this home promises an unforgettable vacation experience.HOME HIGHLIGHTS* Complete Clean Bedding Program - Towels, Linens, & Duvet Covers* 6 Complimentary Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes* Private courtyard* Courtyard with private pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)* Gas Grill* 3 Complimentary Beach Service Sets (6 Chairs, 3 Umbrellas) March - October OnlyFISRT FLOOR* Living room (Play Room)* Bunk Room (4 Twin Beds)* King Bedroom w/ ensuite bathSECOND FLOOR:* Living Room * Kitchen * Dinning Room * 2 King Bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms* Bunk room with 2 twin bedsTHIRD FLOOR: * Primary Bedroom w/ ensuite bathroom*** This home rents on a 7-night Sunday to Sunday Basis during the peak seasons of Spring Break & Summer
